f.title: Comply with terms and conditions of a clinical trial authorization
f.statement: The holder of the s. 3.1 authorization shall comply with any terms and conditions of the authorization (the actor's full description and the source of the terms and conditions are from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 3.2 Terms and conditions - clinical trial authorizations
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 3.2
f.applicability: Clinical trials of drugs, devices or prescribed foods for a special dietary purpose. From the section, not quoted: s. 3.2: the holder of an authorization referred to in s. 3.1 shall comply with any terms and conditions of the authorization that are imposed by the Minister under regulations made under paragraph 30(1)(b.3). Contravention involving a therapeutic product is an offence under s. 31.2(2)(a.2).

f.title: Minister may order a person to provide information in their control when a therapeutic product may present a serious risk
f.statement: The Minister may order a person to provide information where a therapeutic product may present a serious risk of injury to human health (the 'believes' trigger and the scope of information are from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.1(1) Power to require information - serious risk
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.1(1)
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (as defined in s. 2). From the section, not quoted: s. 21.1(1): the order covers information that is in the person's control and that the Minister believes is necessary to determine whether the product presents such a risk.
f.exceptions: Permitted power of the Minister. Non-compliance with an order made under ss. 21.1 to 21.32 is an offence under s. 31.2(1) (row 0011), but the Act states no separate 'shall comply' duty for the addressee.

rows.review_note: Review: kept Permitted (Minister's 'may order'); not restated as a company duty because the Act states no 'shall comply' duty - enforcement is via the s. 31.2 offence for contravening an order. Bilingual side-by-side text allows one English line per quote; statement trimmed to the quoted wording, trigger and information scope marked from the section, not quoted; legal_basis filled. Double-check: authority-only power ('may order'); risk trigger and information scope not quoted; no stated 'shall comply' duty.

f.title: Minister may order the authorization holder to modify the label or modify or replace the package
f.statement: Where the Minister believes it necessary to prevent injury to health, the Minister may make an order (the addressee - the authorization holder - and the order to modify the label or modify or replace the package are from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.2 Modification or replacement - labelling or packaging
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.2
f.applicability: Therapeutic products authorized for import or sale. From the section, not quoted: s. 21.2: the Minister may order the holder of a therapeutic product authorization that authorizes the import or sale of a therapeutic product to modify the product's label or to modify or replace its package.
f.exceptions: Permitted power of the Minister. Non-compliance with an order made under ss. 21.1 to 21.32 is an offence under s. 31.2(1) (row 0011), but the Act states no separate 'shall comply' duty for the addressee.

Double-check: authority-only power; quote ('...to prevent injury to health, order the') proves neither the addressee nor the label/package content.

f.title: Minister may order a seller to recall a therapeutic product or send it to a specified place
f.statement: The Minister may order a person who sells the therapeutic product (to recall it or send it to a specified place, where it presents a serious or imminent risk of injury to health - from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.3(1) Minister's powers - risk of injury to health
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.3(1)
f.applicability: Therapeutic products. From the section, not quoted: s. 21.3(1): if the Minister believes that a therapeutic product presents a serious or imminent risk of injury to health, he or she may order a person who sells the product to (a) recall the product or (b) send the product, or cause it to be sent, to a place specified in the order.
f.exceptions: Permitted power of the Minister. The seller's duty after a recall order is stated in s. 21.3(3) (row 0005); non-compliance with the order is an offence under s. 31.2(1).

rows.location: Part I, s. 21.3(1) Minister's powers - risk of injury to health
rows.review_note: Review: kept Permitted (Minister's order power); the company-side duty that the Act does state ('no person shall sell' a recalled product, s. 21.3(3)) is row 0005. Statement trimmed to the quoted wording; risk threshold and order content marked from the section, not quoted; legal_basis filled. Double-check: authority-only power; quote proves 'may order a person who sells the' but not the risk threshold or the recall/send content.

f.title: Recall order may require requesting owners or users to allow corrective action instead of return
f.statement: Where the Minister makes a recall order under s. 21.3(1)(a) and believes that corrective action is effective, the order may require corrective action instead of return (the 'effective means' condition and the order's content are from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.3(2) Recall order - corrective action
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.3(2)
f.applicability: Therapeutic products subject to a recall order. From the section, not quoted: s. 21.3(2): the order may require the person who sells the product to, instead of requesting the product's return, request the product's owner or user to allow corrective action to be taken and then take that corrective action, or cause it to be taken, if the request is accepted.
f.exceptions: Permitted power of the Minister; no separate 'shall comply' duty stated (offence under s. 31.2(1) for contravening the order).

rows.review_note: Review: kept Permitted. Quote proves 'under paragraph (1)(a) and believes that corrective'; corrective-action content marked from the section, not quoted; legal_basis filled. Double-check: authority-only power; quote is a fragment proving only the s. 21.3(1)(a) link and 'believes that corrective'; corrective-action content not quoted.

f.title: Do not sell a therapeutic product that the Minister has ordered to be recalled
f.statement: Subject to subsection 21.3(5), no person shall sell a therapeutic product that is the subject of a recall order (the object of the prohibition is from the section; see applicability).
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.3(3), (5), (6)
f.applicability: Therapeutic products subject to a recall order. From the section, not quoted: s. 21.3(3): no person shall sell a therapeutic product that the Minister orders them, or another person, to recall.
f.exceptions: From the section, not quoted: A person does not contravene this if they sell a product they have been authorized by the Minister under s. 21.3(4) to sell, in accordance with any conditions the Minister establishes (s. 21.3(5)). No conviction unless the person had been notified of the recall order or reasonable steps had been taken to bring it to the notice of those likely to be affected (s. 21.3(6)).

f.title: Minister may authorize sale of a recalled therapeutic product with or without conditions
f.statement: The Minister may authorize a person to sell a therapeutic product (with or without conditions, even after a recall order - from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.3(4)-(5) Power to authorize sale; Exception
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.3(4)-(5)
f.applicability: Therapeutic products subject to a recall order. From the section, not quoted: s. 21.3(4): the Minister may authorize a person to sell a therapeutic product, with or without conditions, even if the Minister has ordered them, or another person, to recall it; s. 21.3(5): a person selling under such an authorization does not contravene s. 21.3(3) provided they sell in accordance with any conditions the Minister establishes.

Double-check: authority-only power; quote proves 'The Minister may authorize a person to sell a' only; recall context and conditions are from the section.

f.title: Minister may order the authorization holder to conduct an assessment and provide the results
f.statement: Subject to the regulations, the Minister may order the authorization holder to conduct an assessment of the therapeutic product and provide the results (the addressee and the order's content are from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.31 Power to require assessment
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.31, 21.321
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs, devices and combinations); natural health products are excluded for s. 21.31 (s. 21.321). From the section, not quoted: s. 21.31: the Minister may order the holder of a therapeutic product authorization to conduct an assessment of the therapeutic product to which the authorization relates and provide the Minister with the results of the assessment.
f.exceptions: Permitted power of the Minister. Non-compliance with an order made under ss. 21.1 to 21.32 is an offence under s. 31.2(1) (row 0011), but the Act states no separate 'shall comply' duty for the addressee.

rows.location: Part I, s. 21.31 Power to require assessment
rows.review_note: Review: kept Permitted (no stated 'shall comply' duty; offence under s. 31.2). Quote proves '21.31 Subject to the regulations, the Minister may order'; addressee and content marked from the section, not quoted; legal_basis filled. Double-check: authority-only power; quote proves 'Subject to the regulations, the Minister may order'; addressee and assessment content not quoted.

f.title: Minister may order the authorization holder to compile information, conduct tests or studies or monitor experience and provide results
f.statement: An order under s. 21.32 may require the holder to compile information, conduct tests or studies or monitor experience in respect of the therapeutic product (the Minister's power, the addressee, the purpose and the duty to provide results are from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.32 Power to require tests, studies, etc.
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.32, 21.321
f.applicability: Therapeutic products (drugs, devices and combinations); natural health products are excluded for s. 21.32 (s. 21.321). From the section, not quoted: s. 21.32: subject to the regulations, the Minister may, for the purpose of obtaining additional information about a therapeutic product's effects on health or safety, order the holder of a therapeutic product authorization to (a) compile information, conduct tests or studies or monitor experience in respect of the product and (b) provide the Minister with the information or the results.
f.exceptions: Permitted power of the Minister. Non-compliance with an order made under ss. 21.1 to 21.32 is an offence under s. 31.2(1) (row 0011), but the Act states no separate 'shall comply' duty for the addressee.

f.title: Do not knowingly make false or misleading statements or provide false or misleading information to the Minister
f.statement: No person shall knowingly make a false or misleading statement to the Minister or provide false or misleading information in connection with a therapeutic product (all after 'false or' is from the section; see applicability).
f.topic: Accuracy of information to the authority
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.6 False or misleading information - therapeutic products
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.6
f.applicability: Therapeutic products. From the section, not quoted: s. 21.6: no person shall knowingly make a false or misleading statement to the Minister - or knowingly provide him or her with false or misleading information - in connection with any matter under this Act concerning a therapeutic product.

f.title: Comply with terms and conditions imposed on the therapeutic product authorization
f.statement: The holder of a therapeutic product authorization shall comply with any terms and conditions of the authorization (the actor and the sources of the terms and conditions are from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part I, s. 21.7 Terms and conditions of authorizations
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 21.7
f.applicability: Therapeutic products. From the section, not quoted: s. 21.7: the holder of a therapeutic product authorization shall comply with any terms and conditions of the authorization that are imposed by the Minister under s. 21.92(3) or under regulations made under paragraph 30(1.2)(b).

f.title: Contravening the Act, regulations or an order under ss. 21.1 to 21.32 for a therapeutic product is an offence
f.statement: Contravening an order made under any of sections 21.1 to 21.32 is an offence (the Act/regulations limb, 'every person who contravenes' and the penalties are from the section; see applicability).
f.clause: Part II, s. 31.2(1) Offences and Punishment
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. F-27), s. 31.2(1)
f.applicability: Therapeutic products. From the section, not quoted: s. 31.2(1): every person who contravenes any provision of the Act or the regulations, as it relates to a therapeutic product, or an order made under any of sections 21.1 to 21.32 is guilty of an offence and liable (a) on indictment to a fine up to $5,000,000, imprisonment up to two years, or both; (b) on summary conviction to a fine up to $250,000, imprisonment up to six months, or both (first offence), and up to $500,000, 18 months, or both (subsequent offence).
f.exceptions: Subject to section 31.4 (from the section, not quoted).
